questions.question:
[05-06] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
G: Dad, let's plan our trip to Australia!
M: Okay, Yumi. Where would you like to go?
G: I'd like to visit the Sydney Opera House.
M: Then how about taking a tour of the Sydney Opera House on the first day? We can learn about the history of the building.
G: That sounds perfect! I'd like to watch a live performance, too.
M: Of course! We can buy tickets to an opera or a classical music concert.
G: I want to see an opera.
M: Okay. I'll look for tickets to an opera.
G: Thank you, Dad. I hope we have a great time.

05. According to the dialog, which one is NOT true?
answers: Yumi and her dad are planning a trip together.
Yumi's dad suggested learning about the building's history through a tour.
Yumi and her dad will tour the building on the last day.
Yumi and her dad will watch an opera on the trip.
There is more than one option for the performance they can watch.

[19-22] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.
Tuesday, August 2
Today we went to a culture center. We learned about traditional Hawaiian culture there. First, we learned what some Hawaiian words mean. "Aloha" is used to say "hello" or "goodbye," and "mahalo" means "thank you." Then it was hula dance time! Surprisingly, many of the movements represented things in nature. [a] ________, if you raise your arms above your head in a circle, (A) 그것은 달을 상징한다. When I danced hula, I could feel the Hawaiian people's love for nature.
On the way back to Soobin's house, we saw a big, beautiful rainbow. Soobin explained, "You can often see rainbows in Hawaii. So, Hawaii is called the Rainbow State."
